newsitem.title: USA: Ringer sees FY96 loss less than year ago.
newsitem.headline: Ringer sees FY96 loss less than year ago.

text.p: Ringer Corp said Wednesday it expects its net loss for the fiscal year ended Monday to be significantly less than a year ago.
The company reported a net loss of $2.2 million, or $0.20 a share, in fiscal 1995.
The fertilizer and pesticide marketer also said it expected sales increases of three to four percent. The company reported net sales of $14.2 million a year ago.

"We believe we have successfully stabilized our business and positioned it effectively for both internal and external growth," Ringer chief executive Stanley Goldberg said in a news release. He said the company generated positive cash flow from operations for the first time since it became public.
These results occurred despite a decline in fertilizer sales due mainly to unseasonal weather earlier in 1996, Goldberg said.
